# The Cooperative Agency

> The Cooperative Agency, based in Baton Rouge, serves Louisiana and the surrounding area and runs the whole marketing and sales engine for car dealerships and other businesses: strategy, content, social, reporting, systems, AI and custom apps. We act as an outsourced Chief Technology Officer (CTO) and Marketing Director, so clients have fewer, smarter partners instead of more vendors.

Backed by two decades of hands-on dealership marketing, sales and systems experience, we blend creative horsepower with operational strategy: streamlining vendors, maximizing manufacturer co-op, and fixing the cracks where leads and dollars get lost. Automotive is our deepest specialty, and the same systems-driven approach serves small businesses, startups and restaurants.

## What we do

- **Outsourced CTO and Marketing Director:** We manage the entire marketing and sales tech stack, aligning creative, tools and tactics with business goals, not vendor agendas.
- **PostEngine (our own social publishing software):** We built PostEngine in-house to run social media for every client; it replaced the third-party scheduler we used before. Posting rules by department (for dealers: new cars, service, parts) put the right content on Instagram, Facebook and Google Business on the right days, timed to promotions, seasons and the local market. Every post is reviewed before it publishes.
- **GM Weekly:** A custom weekly report we build, run and maintain for each store, pulling traffic, inventory, leads, response times and close rates into one page with real dates. We then sit down with the general manager and turn it into next steps: which leads are slipping, which sources aren't closing, where the team needs help.
- **AI systems and custom apps:** More and more of our work runs through AI and apps we build ourselves, from publishing and reporting tools to lead handling and website chat.
- **Optimize spend and maximize co-op:** We identify waste, clean up lead flow and manage co-op claims, with original equipment manufacturer (OEM) compliance in mind.
- **Custom photo, video and drone content:** Original content of the real business, local settings, real staff, real inventory. No stock images. Drone work is included.
- **Brand consistency across channels:** Content deployed across Google Business, websites, paid ads, email and social.
- **Vendor management:** We eliminate overlapping services and become the single point of contact for marketing operations.
- **Lead and CRM fixes:** We diagnose and fix lead flow, customer relationship management (CRM) setup and follow-up processes.
- **Fast turnaround:** Creative is built in-house and can deploy within hours for sales events, incentives and urgent updates.

## Who we work with

- Car dealerships, from single rooftops to multi-location groups, across Louisiana and the surrounding area, with boots-on-the-ground content creation.
- Other businesses: small business startups (website and brand consulting, go-to-market strategy, systems setup), restaurants (websites, menu content, photography, social media) and other verticals.
